**Visual analysis of test image:**
- Soybean leaf with scattered small, angular dark reddish-brown spots
- Yellow-green halos visible around several lesions
- Spots appearing on upper leaf surface, some coalescing near leaf margins
- Tissue death at edges where lesions merge

**Comparison with reference:**
The reference Bacterial_Blight collage shows the same pattern: small angular spots with yellowish-green halos and dark reddish-brown centers. The test image matches closely — angular lesions (following veins), yellow halo surrounds, coalescing near margins causing necrosis.

This distinguishes it from Septoria_brown_spot (which lacks the prominent yellow halo and is more common on lower leaves) and Frogeye (which has a distinct reddish-purple ring border with gray centers).
